cc:Work.dc:title: FlexBox - BreadBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
A BreadBox with a gliding door
Beware of the rolling shutter effect! Use wax on sliding surfaces.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes BreadBox --x 160 --y 90 --h 110 --radius 30 --thickness 3 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes BreadBox --x --y --h --radius --reference
